notes: Fixed: update notes were not being shown when you opened the app after an update. The check had been switched off by accident since v1.18.0, so unless you went looking under Settings you had no way of knowing what had changed - including fixes that made your numbers more accurate. Opening the app after an update now shows you what changed.
If several updates have landed since you last looked, the most recent few are shown rather than the entire history, with the rest still available under Settings.
